reviews_5s:
I like this funnel because it's the soft plastic and not the brittle Chinese stuff that always breaks.Large size that's hard to find. Happy with this funnel.Heavy plastic. Exactly what I was looking for.I used it as a squirrel baffle on the bird feeder. Works great !I bought these for one purpose. I have hanging bird feeders and the squirrels would jump and land onto the top of them and hang on, while eating the bird seed below. I slid these over the tops of the bird feeders and waited to see if it worked. I laughed so hard when it jumped up onto the funnel. It tried to hang on and slipped off holding itself by the front feet, like trying to do a chin-up, and the fell about 6' to the ground.How can you "love" a plastic funnel which is what 5 stars means according to Amazon. Well, I do like that it was cheap and functions well for the purpose purchased, but I don't "ooh" and "aah" over it or stroke its side!I wanted a LARGE funnel to use to fill a gallon jug with a fruit juice concentrate and water; every other funnel was just too small, and I'd make a major mess. This is so nice and wide that there are NO spills whatsoever! I LOVE it.A nice durable funnel. The spout is a little smaller than I hoped. At the junction of the funnel and the spout, the OD is 1.45 inches the ID is 1.20 inches. At the tip of the funnel, the OD is 0.69 inches and the ID is 0.54 inches. At the top of the funnel, the OD is 8.25 inches and the ID is 7.5. The photo doesn't show it, but there is a tab with a hole to hang the funnel on the outer edge of the top.

The funnel says "Made in China" and "Contains or produces a chemical known by the State of California to cause cancer." So don't burn it and breath the fumes.I did not like the price...$6.50 for a plastic funnel is a little overpriced....but...I needed it and did not have time to shop aroundI will no longer be the sloppiest guy in the kitchen. I can reuse my gallon water jugs to make Tang on demand, powdered milk 3 quarts at a time.
This is not your mothers tiny funnel. It may well have uses elsewhere. Anything you can think of pouring from one place to another - go for it. The inside diameter is 71/2 in. at the top and 5/8th's in. at the opening. Outstanding - does dry measure with a little tapping, wet if you pour slowly. Guys, we need help in the kitchen. Help is on the way. I can hear the cavalry charge already. Jimmy Warner Design
